name: Distribution as a Service for Side Projects

mentions.name: Distribution as a Service for Side Projects
mentions.description: A SaaS that helps hobbyist vibe coders get real users for their side projects through a 4-stage flow: idea generation (or bring-your-own idea), idea validation, distribution while building, and launch distribution. Positioning: distribution as a service.
mentions.problem: Hobbyist coders with AI FOMO struggle to get real users for their side projects
mentions.audience: Hobbyist vibe coders building side projects
mentions.source_excerpt: I am currently building a SaaS for hobbyist vibe coders with a severe case of AI fomo to help them get real users for their side projects. Doing this with a 4-stage flow: idea generator (or BYOI) → idea validation → distribution-while-building → launch distribution. I'm essentially building distribution as a service.
